card.name: Small linking words in label phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words or spaces in fixed label phrases, most strongly the word 'or' in 'when prescribing or dispensing' in opioid warnings. It also fires on a space before an age number and on 'of' after 'trimester'.

modes.label: Prescribing or dispensing
modes.description: The word 'or' between 'prescribing' and 'dispensing' in the opioid diversion warning.

modes.label: Linking word in a set phrase
modes.description: A short linking word such as 'of' or 'in' inside a stock medical phrase.
modes.example: in the second and third trimester<< of>> pregnancy.
